title: 口语练习
subtitle: 每天 10 分钟 · 共 5 天
steps: 点 🔊 听一遍，听清语调
一句一句跟着读，声音要大，不怕错
读完点「今天完成了」打卡

sentences.en: Our class had a gala yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我们班昨天开了联欢会。

sentences.en: She wore a red dress and sang a song.
sentences.zh: 她穿了一条红裙子，还唱了一首歌。

sentences.en: The judge woke up early and read the notice.
sentences.zh: 裁判很早醒来，读了通知。

sentences.en: A writer came to the book fair.
It was the most exciting book fair ever.
sentences.zh: 那是有史以来最精彩的书展。
